statement.ru: Тихоходки выживали в открытом космосе.
statement.en: Tardigrades have survived in open space.

why: In 2007 (FOTON-M3) tardigrades survived 10 days exposed to space vacuum and UV.

statement.ru: Паук-сенокосец — самый ядовитый паук, просто не может прокусить кожу.
statement.en: The daddy longlegs spider has the deadliest venom, it just can't bite through skin.

why: An urban legend: pholcid venom is not medically significant.

statement.ru: Скорпион светится в ультрафиолете.
statement.en: A scorpion glows under ultraviolet light.

why: Fluorescent chemicals in the exoskeleton glow under UV.

statement.ru: Если разрезать дождевого червя пополам, получатся два червя.
statement.en: Cut an earthworm in half and you get two worms.

why: Myth: the tail half usually dies; at best the head end regrows a tail.

statement.ru: Каждая садовая улитка — одновременно и самец, и самка.
statement.en: Every garden snail is both male and female at once.

why: Garden snails are hermaphrodites producing both male and female gametes.

statement.ru: Укус тарантула смертелен для человека.
statement.en: A tarantula bite can kill a person.

why: All tarantulas are venomous but the venom is not deadly to humans.

statement.ru: Леопардовые слизни спариваются, вися в воздухе на нитке слизи.
statement.en: Leopard slugs mate hanging in mid-air from a rope of slime.

why: The pair hangs suspended from a branch on a thick thread of mucus.

statement.ru: Клещ умеет прыгать на свою жертву.
statement.en: A tick can jump onto its victim.

why: A common misconception: ticks cannot jump; they wait on grass (questing).

statement.ru: Большинство бактерий в теле человека вредны.
statement.en: Most of the bacteria in the human body are harmful.

why: Most bacteria in and on the body are harmless and many are beneficial.

statement.ru: Есть паук, который питается в основном растениями.
statement.en: There is a spider that lives mainly on plants.

why: Bagheera kiplingi eats mostly plant tissue (Beltian bodies of acacias).

statement.ru: Скорпионы откладывают яйца.
statement.en: Scorpions lay eggs.

why: All known scorpion species give live birth; young ride on the mother's back.

statement.ru: Есть паук, который живёт под водой в домике из пузыря воздуха.
statement.en: There is a spider that lives underwater in a home made of an air bubble.

why: Argyroneta aquatica spends almost all its life underwater in a silk air bell.

statement.ru: Кишечная палочка водится только у больных людей.
statement.en: E. coli bacteria are found only in sick people.

why: Most E. coli strains are a normal, mostly harmless part of every healthy gut.

statement.ru: Бактерии мельче вирусов.
statement.en: Bacteria are smaller than viruses.

why: Most viruses are about one-hundredth the size of most bacteria.

statement.ru: Самец паука-павлина танцует перед самкой, чтобы ей понравиться.
statement.en: A male peacock spider dances for the female to win her over.

why: Males display colourful abdominal flaps and dance during courtship.

statement.ru: Плесень на хлебе — это колония бактерий.
statement.en: The mould on bread is a colony of bacteria.

why: Mould is a fungus, not bacteria.

statement.ru: Пауки умеют летать на паутинках за сотни километров.
statement.en: Spiders can fly hundreds of kilometres on threads of silk.

why: Ballooning journeys range from metres to hundreds of kilometres; spiders land on ships mid-ocean.

statement.ru: Главная еда паука-птицееда — птицы.
statement.en: The bird-eating spider's main food is birds.

why: Despite its name, the Goliath birdeater rarely preys on birds.

statement.ru: Один паук в Австралии прожил 43 года.
statement.en: One spider in Australia lived to the age of 43.

why: Number 16, a wild trapdoor spider (Gaius villosus), died in 2016 aged about 43.

statement.ru: На лицах у многих взрослых живут крошечные клещи.
statement.en: Many adults have tiny mites living on their faces.

why: Demodex face mites: studies find them on half to all adults.

statement.ru: Сколопендра умеет ловить летучих мышей.
statement.en: A giant centipede can catch bats.

why: Scolopendra gigantea hangs from cave ceilings and catches bats.

statement.ru: Пылевые клещи кусают людей во сне.
statement.en: Dust mites bite people in their sleep.

why: Dust mites feed on shed skin flakes and mould; the allergy comes from their droppings.

statement.ru: Ядовитые «клыки» сколопендры — это бывшие ноги.
statement.en: A centipede's venomous 'fangs' are really modified legs.

why: Forcipules are modified front legs, not fangs.

statement.ru: Есть многоножка, у которой больше тысячи ног.
statement.en: There is a millipede with more than a thousand legs.

why: Eumillipes persephone (2021): a female with 1,306 legs.

statement.ru: Яд большинства скорпионов может убить человека.
statement.en: Most scorpions have venom that can kill a person.

why: Only about 25 species (under 1%) have venom capable of killing a human.

statement.ru: Мокрица — ракообразное, родственница крабов.
statement.en: A woodlouse is a crustacean, a relative of crabs.

why: Woodlice are terrestrial isopods, i.e. crustaceans, not insects.

statement.ru: Мороз в морозилке убивает бактерии в еде.
statement.en: The cold in a freezer kills the bacteria in food.

why: Freezing only slows or stops bacteria; it does not kill them.

statement.ru: Одна бактерия выдерживает радиацию в 1000 раз сильнее смертельной для человека.
statement.en: There is a bacterium that survives 1,000 times the radiation dose that kills a human.

why: D. radiodurans withstands 5,000 Gy almost unharmed; 5 Gy can kill a human.

statement.ru: Слизевик без всякого мозга находит кратчайший путь в лабиринте.
statement.en: A slime mould, with no brain at all, finds the shortest path through a maze.

why: Physarum retracts from everywhere except the shortest route between two food sources.

statement.ru: Тихоходку можно разглядеть только в электронный микроскоп.
statement.en: A tardigrade can only be seen with an electron microscope.

why: Tardigrades (0.5 mm, up to 1.3 mm) are viewed under a low-power light microscope by students.

statement.ru: Есть бактерия, которую видно без микроскопа.
statement.en: There is a bacterium you can see without a microscope.

why: Thiomargarita magnifica averages 1 cm, up to 2 cm, visible by unaided eye.

statement.ru: Слизень — близкий родственник дождевого червя.
statement.en: A slug is a close relative of the earthworm.

why: A slug is a gastropod mollusc, a relative of snails; earthworms are annelids.

statement.ru: Если взвесить всё живое на Земле, бактерии уступят только растениям.
statement.en: Weigh all life on Earth, and only plants outweigh the bacteria.

why: Bacterial biomass is exceeded only by plants.

statement.ru: Последняя научная книга Дарвина была о дождевых червях.
statement.en: Darwin's last scientific book was about earthworms.

why: The Formation of Vegetable Mould Through the Action of Worms (1881), his last scientific book.

statement.ru: Клещи водятся даже в Антарктиде.
statement.en: Ticks are found even in Antarctica.

why: Ticks have been found in Antarctica, where they feed on penguins.

statement.ru: Пиявка — родственница дождевого червя.
statement.en: A leech is a relative of the earthworm.

why: Leeches are annelid worms, like earthworms.

statement.ru: Все пиявки живут в воде.
statement.en: All leeches live in water.

why: Most live in fresh water, but some species are terrestrial (land leeches) or marine.

statement.ru: Клещ напивается крови за пару минут.
statement.en: A tick fills up on blood in a couple of minutes.

why: Hard ticks stay attached until engorged, which takes days or weeks.

statement.ru: У дождевого червя есть глаза.
statement.en: An earthworm has eyes.

why: Earthworms have no eyes, only light-sensitive cells in the skin.
